findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_recent_registrations · Private data: find_predicates, classify_device, get_recent_registrations, get_coverage · Public sink: get_registration_timeline.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_recent_registrations · Private data: find_predicates, classify_device, get_recent_registrations, get_coverage · Public sink: get_registration_timeline

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
